description: Check the TLS certificate a service is serving, in the style of a Nagios check_ssl plugin: the name is covered, days to expiry, the chain verifies, and optionally the SHA-256 fingerprint matches. One status line with performance data. Exit 0 OK, 1 WARNING, 2 CRITICAL, 3 UNKNOWN. Makes no changes and reads no files on the host.

name.description: Host name the certificate must cover. Also sent as SNI.

host.description: Host or address to connect to. Default localhost.

starttls.description: STARTTLS protocol as openssl s_client -starttls takes it (xmpp, smtp, imap, pop3, ftp ...). Omit for direct TLS.

warn_days.description: WARNING when fewer days than this remain. Default 30.

crit_days.description: CRITICAL when fewer days than this remain. Default 7.

fingerprint.description: CRITICAL unless the served certificate has this SHA-256 fingerprint (hex, colons optional).

ca_file.description: CA file on the agent to verify against instead of the system store.
